title: Bridge battery disconnects
symptom: Bridge battery warnings randomly pop up on nightly versions, causing xDrip to stop reading glucose values and requiring app restart. The warning appears even after changing the battery in Blucon, and the battery is fine as validated by measuring voltage.
cause: Possible bug in persistent storage or Blucon stores battery low info even after battery change, taking a while to correct.
fix: Suggested to disable collector battery alert via settings / Alarm / extra Alarms / collector battery alert, or change battery type to Sony.
evidence_quote: settings / Alarm / extra Alarms / collector battery alert? but if after a few hours after changing battery you get battery low then you might change battery type, you should use one from Sony.
